tasks.short: Ring up the order, take payment and make change, write charge slips for account customers, and wash hands or change gloves between money and food.

steps.what: Customer pays in cash or by card at the counter
Short order cook rings up the order on the till
Short order cook accepts payments and makes change
Short order cook writes charge slips for account customers
Short order cook washes hands or changes gloves between money and food

tasks.design: The till ({OTHER}) sends the amount to the card terminal, so the cook does not type it twice, and contactless payment means fewer cash handovers and fewer glove changes. Account customers are booked to their account on the till instead of on a handwritten slip, and the till lists them for monthly invoicing. Ringing up and taking cash from those who pay cash stay with the cook.
tasks.previous_blocker: Amounts were typed on the terminal by hand and charge slips written on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Tills link to card terminals and keep customer accounts.
tasks.still_hard: Regulars who pay cash keep the cook handling money between orders.
tasks.human_edge: Keeping the grill and the queue moving at the same time.

reach.learn: Whether account lists from the till cut invoicing errors.

evidence.claim: Tills can send amounts to linked card terminals and keep customer accounts for later invoicing.
No Annex III point of the AI Act covers payments in a food business.

assumptions: Boundary: from the customer's payment to clean hands for the next order; monthly invoicing is outside.
Input contract: prices and account customers kept by the owner in the till; fallback is typing amounts and paper slips.
Customers tapping a card spend about the same time as paying cash; their time is priced as customer time.
Hygiene steps still follow every cash handover.
research_questions: Do glove changes per hour fall?

incremental.description: Short order cook sorts out failed card payments.
Customers tap a card instead of handing over cash.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a snack bar where most regulars pay cash; high: most customers pay contactless.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The short order cook keeps cooking and serving the queue; typing amounts, paper slips and some cash handling shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A cook who spends the counter time on the food.
